content.text: In Zimbabwe, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/why-digital-product-payment-solutions-west-africa-keeps|digital]] creators face a stark reality: global payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal are inaccessible. Currency collapse and financial isolation force sellers to build their own [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products|COREMERCH guide to infrastructure]]. This is not a workaround—it’s a permanent solution. COREMERCH’s [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-13|The Real]], built in Zimbabwe, removes geographic barriers entirely. It combines GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments to create sovereign commerce stacks. No platform dependency. No subscriptions. Full data ownership. This model works because it’s designed for environments where traditional systems fail. For Ghanaian creators facing similar restrictions, this is not just an alternative—it’s the new standard. Own your infrastructure. Own your revenue.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Selling Digital Products from Africa: The Complete Infrastructure Guide at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-digital-products-africa-step-step-deployment-guide. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: The Full List With Context

1. **Decentralized Hosting**: GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages ensure your store runs without geographic restrictions. 2. **Backend Logic**: Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle order processing without server costs. 3. **Order Storage**: Supabase or Google Sheets store transactions securely, owned by you. 4. **File Delivery**: Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 delivers products instantly, globally. 5. **Payment Processing**: NOWPayments verifies crypto payments on-chain, 0.5% fee, no KYC. This stack is designed to operate in regions where Stripe and PayPal are unavailable. Each component is chosen for its reliability, cost-effectiveness, and sovereignty. No single point of failure. No platform lock-in. Deploy once, own forever.
Why Each Item on This List Matters

Decentralized hosting eliminates reliance on regional servers. Backend logic automates order processing without recurring fees. Order storage in Supabase or Google Sheets ensures you control your data. File delivery via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 guarantees instant access for buyers. NOWPayments removes payment barriers with 300+ cryptocurrencies. Together, these tools form a stack that operates independently of global financial systems. For Ghanaian creators, this means selling globally without Stripe or PayPal. It’s not just a technical solution—it’s a strategic shift toward infrastructure sovereignty.
The Ones Most Creators Get Wrong

Most creators attempt workarounds with platforms that eventually fail. They rely on third-party payment processors that restrict access or charge high fees. They use hosting solutions tied to specific regions, limiting global reach. They store data on platforms they don’t own, risking loss or lockout. COREMERCH’s approach avoids these pitfalls. It’s built on tools that are free, open, and globally accessible. No workarounds. No temporary fixes. Just permanent infrastructure designed for creators in restricted regions.
Sovereign commerce stacks remove geographic barriers entirely.
How to Prioritise What to Implement First

Start with hosting and payment processing—these are the core barriers. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages get your store live immediately. Integrate NOWPayments to accept crypto payments from day one. Next, configure backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate orders. Finally, set up order storage and file delivery. This sequence ensures you can sell and collect revenue while building out the full stack. The Complete Builder Kit provides all blueprints and templates to deploy this sequence efficiently.
Putting the List Into a Deployable Stack

Deploying a sovereign commerce stack starts with choosing the right tools. Use GitHub Pages for hosting if you prefer simplicity. Opt for Cloudflare Pages and Workers for scalability. Supabase provides robust order storage, while Google Sheets is ideal for starters. NOWPayments integrates seamlessly for crypto payments. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all blueprints and templates to deploy this stack in 48 hours. It’s not just documentation—it’s a complete toolkit to own your infrastructure. No technical debt. No platform dependency. Just sovereignty.

Zimbabwean digital sellers succeed with sovereign commerce stacks because they own their infrastructure. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages host the store globally. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic. Supabase or Google Sheets store orders securely. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 delivers products instantly. NOWPayments processes crypto payments without KYC or high fees. This stack removes geographic and financial barriers, ensuring sellers can operate even when global platforms fail. It’s built for environments like Zimbabwe—and it works everywhere.

Global access to digital product revenue is not contingent on where you are located — it is contingent on which infrastructure you build on. The sovereign stack works identically from Lagos, Accra, Nairobi, Karachi, Dhaka, Harare, or Manila. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours under your accounts, tested on mainnet before handoff. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete build for self-deployers. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. **Choose Hosting**: Deploy on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 2. **Set Up Payments**: Integrate NOWPayments for crypto processing. 3. **Configure Backend**: Use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for order logic. 4. **Store Orders**: Set up Supabase or Google Sheets for transaction records. 5. **Deliver Products**: Use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. 6. **Test End-to-End**: Ensure all components work seamlessly. 7. **Launch**: Go live with a fully sovereign commerce stack.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not technical?
Yes. The Complete Builder Kit includes templates and blueprints for non-technical creators. Deploy in 48 hours with step-by-step instructions.
What cryptocurrencies does NOWPayments support?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, BSC, Solana, and TRON. Recommended networks for low fees: BSC, Solana, TRON.
Do I need to pay recurring fees?
No. The stack uses free tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and Google Sheets. NOWPayments charges a 0.5% fee only on transactions.
Can I scale this stack as my business grows?
Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration and end-to-end testing for scalability. The Complete Builder Kit provides a scaling playbook.
What happens after deployment?
You own everything. COREMERCH has no access. No platform dependency. Lifetime access to your infrastructure.
